notes:
SDX Tools now reports anonymous usage counts, so the tools people actually use get the attention and broken ones surface without anyone filing a report. One small batch is sent per day when Revit starts: which tools ran, whether each run succeeded, failed or was cancelled, and the SDX and Revit versions
No user names, machine names, file paths or model contents ever leave your machine
Usage reporting can be turned off any time under Preferences > Advanced, where a button also shows the exact payload that would be sent
Administrators can switch usage reporting off for a whole computer, overriding the per-user setting
Slope Lines is now counted in the Usage Counter; it had been missing since the tool was added
